excerpt.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
excerpt.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

texts.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
texts.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

sections.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
sections.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

texts.zh: [from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系的重力稳定是由小行星带中释放出来的暗物质维系起来的。这些发射源被一台位于中心行星上的超级电脑控制着。中控电脑的记录表明，整个恒星系是一处由某个远古文明建设的重力操控实验设施。
texts.en: The gravitational stability of the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system is maintained by Dark Matter emitters positioned within its asteroid belt. These emitters are controlled by a supercomputer located on the central planet. Records from this central computer suggest the entire system was an experimental site for gravity manipulation, established by an ancient civilization.

tooltips.zh: 向所有重力操控装置小行星添加£physics£ +1和£sr_dark_matter£ +1
tooltips.en: Adds £physics£ +1 and £sr_dark_matter£ +1 to every Gravity Manipulator Asteroid
